editorial: When the line between ally and enemy dissolves, every heartbeat feels like an interrogation. The film pulls you into a future war where an ex-special forces operative hunts the mastermind behind AI, turning the hunt into a psychological maze. Joaquin Phoenix carries every scene with almost no dialogue, letting his quiet menace echo in dripping neon corridors. A slight pacing snag in the third act leaves the climax feeling almost exhausted. If you crave a dark, slow-burn sci-fi thriller that rewards patience and a love of grim, cyberpunk visuals, this is the watch for you.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of tense, dystopian thrillers who appreciate grim storytelling.
